Designed for the modern golfer.

Crafted from AAA Cabretta leather, this glove delivers the soft, responsive touch serious players rely on. It molds to your hand for a true second-skin fit, giving you total control through every swing while maintaining the breathability needed for long rounds in warm conditions.

The result is a glove that stays supple, grips consistently, and holds its shape longer than standard leather round after round.

Driver Headcover — Weather-Resistant Protection, USA-Made Quality

Crafted in the USA with performance and durability in mind, this premium driver headcover features a DRYTEX outer shell that repels moisture and shields your club from the elements. Inside, a soft sherpa lining cushions your driver for superior protection on the go. Finished with an elastic opening for a snug fit that stays secure round after round.

  • DRYTEX outer shell for water and weather resistance
  • Soft sherpa interior protects against dings and scratches
  • Elastic opening ensures a snug, stay-put fit
  • Designed and made in the USA
  • Built for all-weather performance and everyday play

✦ Made to Order
Each headcover is crafted to order just for you. Please allow 7–10 business days for production before your order ships. Standard returns and exchanges apply.

The Details

Product Overview — Built for the rounds that don't go as planned. Premium materials, a clean modern look, and protection where it matters most.

Materials & Construction — DRYTEX water-resistant shell, plush sherpa interior, and an elastic-bound opening built to hold its shape season after season.

Protection & Fit — A snug elastic fit keeps the cover securely on your driver and stops it slipping in the bag.

Designed with an unstructured crown, strap back, and curved bill, the Lazy Palm mirrors the typical "dad" hat design. Available in multiple colors to match any look! 

Fabric: 100% Cotton
Back: Adjustable Strapback
Visor: Curved
Patch Material: Woven Label

Performance Snapback – Built for the Course and Beyond
Engineered for breathability, comfort, and style, our performance snapback is designed to handle the heat, sweat, and elements of your round. Made with lightweight, moisture-wicking polyester and treated with a water-resistant coating, this cap keeps you cool and dry through all 18 — and wherever the day takes you. A structured fit, curved visor, and sleek woven patch complete the look.
• 100% performance polyester with waterproof coating
• Moisture-wicking interior keeps sweat in check
• Lightweight and breathable for all-day wear
• Clean design with PVC patch branding
• Adjustable snapback closure (OSFA: 6 5/8 – 7 5/8)
• 3.5" crown height 5 panel with slight curve visor
Made for performance. Styled for anywhere.

In golf, as in life, rhythm and tempo are everything. Slow it down, trust the tempo, and find your rhythm.

You can have all the speed in the world, but without a smooth, repeating cadence, you're just swinging blindly. The Rhythm Hoodie is designed as a daily reminder of that exact truth. Whether you're standing over a tight approach shot on the 18th or easing into your weekend, this hoodie is built to help you find your pace.

Crafted with an ultra-soft, premium cotton-poly blend, it delivers the ideal warmth for early morning tee times, post-round drinks at the clubhouse, or casual days around town. The clean, minimalist front keeps it versatile, while the bold "Find Your Rhythm" typography across the back makes a statement to everyone in your group.

Features

Premium Fleece Fabric: Super-soft, mid-weight warmth that moves with you without restricting your swing.

Athletic Fit: Tailored for comfort on and off the course not too baggy, not too tight.

Double-Layer Hood: Keeps its shape with a smooth, structured drawcord-free hood design.

Kangaroo Pocket: Perfect for keeping hands warm or stashing extra tees and balls.

Embrace the essence of comfort and style with the Local Hoodie, featuring our iconic Palm logo proudly displayed as a sewn-on patch over the heart. Crafted from the softest fleece for ultimate comfort, this hoodie is designed to be your go-to for any occasion. Whether you're hitting the town or relaxing at home, the Local Hoodie combines simplicity with a touch of elegance, making it a timeless addition to your wardrobe.

Performance Polo – Lightweight Comfort, All-Day Confidence
Built for the course but ready for wherever your day takes you, the Palm Performance Polo combines moisture-wicking tech, lightweight stretch fabric, and clean style for a modern take on a classic essential. Made from a breathable poly-elastane blend, it keeps you cool, dry, and unrestricted through every swing. Whether you're chasing birdies or grabbing drinks after the round, this polo moves with you.
• Moisture-wicking to keep sweat in check
• Lightweight and breathable for all-day wear
• 4-way stretch fabric for full range of motion
• Athletic fit with classic Palm attitude
• Fabric blend: 94% Polyester / 6% Elastane
Swing freely. Smile often. Look sharp doing it.

Coasty Polo – From Office to Tee Box to Dinner
The Coasty Polo is built for every part of your day — and every part of your life. Made from a breathable, performance-ready spandex blend, it offers stretch, softness, and a tailored fit that transitions seamlessly from work to the course to wherever you end up next. Tuck it in for meetings, untuck it for your twilight tee time, and roll straight into dinner without missing a beat.
• Lightweight, breathable performance fabric for all-day comfort
• Versatile stretch blend for unrestricted movement
• Polished enough for work, relaxed enough for play
• Wear tucked or untucked — looks sharp either way
• Designed for lifestyle versatility on and off the course
When one polo does it all, you wear it on repeat.

Double the laughs, double the meaning. Introducing the Make It a Double Tee. Whether you’re talking about that double bogey on the course or a well-deserved double shot at the 19th hole, this shirt has you covered. Crafted from soft, premium fabric, this tee is perfect for golfers who know the highs, the lows, and the toast that follows. Comfortable enough for the course and stylish enough for the bar, it’s a nod to those who take the game (and the good times) in stride.

Because whether it’s on the scorecard or in your glass, sometimes you’ve just got to make it a double. Cheers!

Our premium soft t-shirt blend, designed to elevate your comfort to new level. With a unique brushed finish, this shirt luxurious to the touch and sets it apart for the rest. It offers the cozy feeling reminiscent of a flannel shirt on a crispy fall morning. Our premium shirt is a versatile unisex fit. For those who prefer a looser fit, we encourage you to size up. Enjoy unparalleled softness and the modern appeal of this superior garment. Palm, where comfort meets style effortlessly.

Fabric - 60% combed ringspun cotton / 40% polyester 

    Fit - Modern/Unisex. For those who prefer a looser fit, we encourage you to size up. 

    Weight- 4.3 oz. Lightweight. Not too heavy and not too light!

    NOTICE: If you dry your shirts on high heat, it is suggested that you size up.

Caddie Towel – Built for Golf Purists
The go-to towel for traditionalists who care about clean clubs and clean style. The Caddie Towel is made from 100% high-absorbency cotton with a ribbed construction designed to wipe down irons, wedges, and grips with ease. Oversized for function and ready for your bag, this towel is made for the player who respects the game — and their gear.
• 100% cotton for maximum absorbency and softness
• Ribbed texture for effective cleaning and moisture control
• Generous 42” x 19” size – ideal for full-round performance
Whether you’re walking 18 or grinding on the range, this towel is your silent workhorse.

The Out of Bounds Towel is designed with more in mind than just cleaning clubs. Crafted from rugged suede with a printed topo-map pattern, it’s oversized for golf but rolls up compactly for camping or hiking. Built to handle dirt, mud, and miles.

Palm Golf Towel – Waffle Knit with Durable Carabiner

We've teamed up with our friends at Surfside for a capsule of collaborative gear that you'll want whether you're out on the course or anywhere else you're sipping your favorite flavors! 

Quick Dry, Maximum Clean
The Palm Golf Towel features a unique waffle knit design, engineered for efficient cleaning and quick drying. Whether it’s grass, sand, mud, or dirt, the pattern lifts away debris with ease, keeping your clubs and balls spotless. Unlike cotton towels, the waffle knit cleans without scratching, making it an essential tool for every golfer.

Durable Carabiner for Easy Attachment
Easily clip your towel to your golf bag with the built-in carabiner, laser-etched with the Palm logo for a touch of style. The carabiner ensures quick access, so you can clean up mid-round without a hassle.

Compact and Convenient Size
Measuring 14" x 36", this towel provides ample coverage while taking up less space on your bag. It’s perfect for golfers who like to carry light without sacrificing functionality.

Premium Material for High Absorbency
Crafted from a special blend of 80% polyester and 20% polyamide, this towel delivers maximum water absorbency, ensuring your hands and clubs stay dry during your game.

The Palm Golf Divot Tool has a unique hand-drawn design that provides more comfort when repairing ball marks. The "U-Shape" top is designed to allow your club to rest, without getting dirty or wet on the ground. The Divot Repair Tool also includes a bottle opener.

Sip on your favorite drink and compliment it with premium, American-made coasters. Available in brown or black.

  • Made in the USA
  • 100% Genuine Leather
  • Exterior PALM debossed logo

At Palm, we look for products that are an extension of us and tell a story. Our leather products began at some of the country's oldest tanneries, allowing them to patina and withstand the test of time.

Hand-cut and hand-stitched locally in Costa Mesa, California, Palm leather accessories compliment your style while allowing you to write your own narrative. Your story begins where we leave off, so cheers to the unwritten adventure ahead, and always remember to #swingandsmile.

Swing at your own risk! Bringing our beach roots to the course, we’ve teamed up with the crew over at Palm Golf to build a fresh look that doesn’t mind a little time in the bunkers. The Dangerous Rips G-Papi was designed around our signature comfort formula and includes nitro-infused cushioning, all-day support, and a spikeless tread. Get these bad boys on the tee box and let it rip!

 

Bonus: Limited Edition REEF x Palm Golf Keychain Float

t: Palm x Precision Pro Titan Elite Rangefinder
body: Palm x Precision Pro Titan Elite golf laser rangefinder with slope, GPS, and magnetic cart mount. Locks the flag to 400 yards with 6x magnification and a 24mm lens. Shows front, center, and back of green GPS distances in the viewfinder, with Bluetooth app connectivity and Find My Rangefinder tracking. Slope adjusts for uphill and downhill shots with a tournament-legal toggle. Magnesium alloy shell, IP67 waterproof, USB-C rechargeable for about 50 rounds per charge. Weight 14 oz, dimensions 4.87 x 3.4 x 1.7 in, 18 mm eye relief, 5 to 999 yard range. Golf Monthly Editor's Choice 2025. Includes rangefinder, USB-C charging cord, hard carrying case, quick start guide.
